'''Han Solo''', known only as '''Han''' until being given the surname '''Solo''', was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] [[smuggler]] and hero of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. He rose from an impoverished childhood to become [[captain]] of the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'', a leader in the Rebel Alliance and an instrumental figure in the [[Galactic Civil War]] during the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. Although he did not believe in [[the Force]] controlling his [[destiny]], Han came to believe in the cause of galactic freedom, joining [[Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker]] and [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] in the fight for the Rebellion. Following the war, Han and Leia welcomed a son, [[Ben Solo]], who became the dark knight Kylo Ren after being corrupted by the [[dark side of the Force]]. Although their relationship floundered, Leia hoped that Han, as Ben's [[Parent|father]], could find a way to break the dark side's hold on their son. Han Solo became legendary across [[the galaxy]] as both a smuggler and war hero of the Rebellion.

As a young man fighting for survival on the mean streets of [[Corellia]], Han yearned to fly among the [[star]]s with dreams of becoming the galaxy's best [[pilot]]. With a fellow [[scrumrat]] named [[Qi'ra]], Han lived as a street thief with Corellia's notorious [[White Worms]] gang until an important deal with [[Lady]] [[Proxima]] went bad, causing Han to flee Corellia. He was given the full name "Han Solo" by an [[Drawd Munbrin|Imperial recruitment officer]] while entering the Imperial Academy. He became known as '''Cadet 124-329''' while serving as an [[Imperial cadet]], and was eventually assigned to the [[224th Imperial Armored Division]]. On [[Mimban]], Han met the thief [[Tobias Beckett]] and wound up deserting the Empire and joining his [[Beckett's gang|crew]] to [[Raid on Kessel|steal]] unrefined [[coaxium]] from [[Kessel]] in order to pay a debt to [[Dryden Vos]], a kingpin with the [[Crimson Dawn]] crime syndicate. By the end of this scheme, during which he reunited with Qi'ra, Han was forced to kill his mentor Beckett after a brutal [[Showdown on Savareen|double-cross]]. Han also became rivals and close friends with fellow smuggler [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]] and the [[Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca]], the latter who became his best friend. Calrissian owned the ''Millennium Falcon'', a fast ship with which Han made the [[Kessel Run]] in just twelve [[parsec]]s and won from Lando in a game of [[sabacc]].

With only Chewbacca remaining at his side, as his trusted copilot who swore a [[life debt]] to the Corellian smuggler, Han Solo embarked on a smuggling career under the employ of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure|Jabba]] the [[Hutt]], a notorious [[gangster]] and [[crime lord]] of [[Tatooine]]. After ditching a shipment of [[spice]] to avoid trouble with the Empire, Solo owed a great deal of [[Galactic Credit Standard|money]] to Jabba, who then placed a [[bounty]] on the smuggler's head, as a result. His fortune seemed to have changed when Han and Chewbacca were hired to charter Luke Skywalker, [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]], and the [[droid]]s [[R2-D2]] and [[C-3PO]] to [[Alderaan]], avoiding [[Stormtrooper|Imperial stormtroopers]] who were searching for Luke's droids. However, as they find Alderaan destroyed by the Empire's new [[superweapon]], the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]], Solo became caught up in the rebellion against the Empire, [[Rescue of Princess Leia|rescuing]] Princess Leia Organa, delivering the stolen [[Death Star plans]] to the hidden Rebel base on [[Yavin 4]], and saved Luke from the [[Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] in the [[Battle of Yavin]], allowing Skywalker to destroy the Death Star. Solo fought with the Rebellion for a number of [[Standard year|years]] afterward, taking part in numerous operations and battles against the Empire.

After the [[Battle of Hoth]], Solo sought refuge with Organa—with whom he had fallen in love—Chewbacca, and C-3PO on [[Cloud City]], which was operated by his old friend Lando Calrissian. There, they were captured by [[Darth]] Vader as part of a trap to bait Skywalker to the [[city]]. Solo was [[Carbon-freezing|frozen]] in [[carbonite]] and taken to [[Boba Fett's Palace|Jabba's Palace]] on Tatooine by the [[bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett]], where he remained encased in carbonite for [[Standard month|months]] until he was [[Rescue of Han Solo|rescued]] by his friends. After returning to the [[Rebel Alliance Navy|Alliance Fleet]], Solo was promoted to the [[Military rank|rank]] of [[general]] and was given command of the [[Pathfinders]], a [[special forces]] [[squad]], for the [[Battle of Endor]]. Solo led the Pathfinders to [[Endor]], where he, Organa, Chewbacca, and the special forces team, with the help of the native [[Ewok]]s, destroyed the [[Death Star's shield generator|shield generator]] protecting the [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station|second Death Star]] that was being constructed in [[orbit]]. Their actions allowed the Alliance [[Fleet]] to destroy the superweapon.

The Battle of Endor, which saw the [[death]]s of [[Galactic Emperor|Emperor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]] and Darth Vader, allowed the Rebellion to form the [[New Republic]]. In the early [[Standard day|days]] after Endor, Solo continued to lead the Pathfinders against the Empire. He [[Marriage|married]] Organa, and the two had a son, Ben Solo. The boy struggled with the dark side of the Force—like his mother, who was the daughter of Darth Vader and twin sister of Luke Skywalker, Ben was [[Force-sensitive]]—so Organa sent him to be [[Jedi training|trained]] as a Jedi by Skywalker. Ben was seduced to the dark side by [[Snoke]], [[Supreme Leader]] of the [[First Order]], resulting in the [[Destruction of the Jedi Temple|destruction]] of Skywalker's attempt to rebuild the [[Jedi Order]].

Having lost their son, Solo left and returned to smuggling, and even lost the ''Millennium Falcon'' to numerous thieves. He continued to smuggle until he was brought back into the fight by a [[scavenger]] named [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]] and a defected First Order [[First Order stormtrooper|stormtrooper]] named [[Finn]], who carried with them a droid, [[BB-8]], that had part of a [[Map to Skywalker|map]] to Skywalker's [[Ahch-To|location]]. Solo, who retrieved the ''Falcon'' from Rey and Finn, returned to Organa, who led the [[Resistance]] against the First Order, and fought in the [[Battle of Starkiller Base|battle]] to destroy the First Order superweapon known as [[Starkiller Base]]. During the battle, Solo saw his son, who had taken the name Kylo Ren, and tried to convince him to return home. Instead, Ren stabbed his father with [[Kylo Ren's lightsaber|his lightsaber]]. Mortally wounded, Solo fell to his death in the bowels of the Starkiller weapon. However, Solo's heroic memory survived and his spirit remained alive and appeared in a [[Force vision]] a [[35 ABY|year later]] to convince Ren to abandon the dark side and defeat the resurrected Darth Sidious, after a [[Mission to Kef Bir|duel]] on the [[Death Star ruins|remains]] of the second Death Star between Rey and Ren, being enough for Ben Solo to return and eventually [[Battle of Exegol|sacrifice his own life]] to help Rey end Sidious and the Sith for good.
